title.narrative: Speak it loud; Enhancing the Capacity of Women’s and Girl’s to Prevent and Respond to SGBV at Mersa Town

description.narrative: The Sexual and Gender Based Violences (SGBV) including harmful traditional practices (HTPs) in the Amhara region include but not limited to female genital mutilation (FGM), early marriage, abduction, inheritance marriage and rape. The gender inequality level of Mersa Town along with the just ended war in the Region extremely affecting women and girls to expose them to different forms of SGBV. The problem is aggravated by lack of collaboration among the justice system, legal office and other concerned government offices. Physical (domestic violence), Economical (denial of access to resource) and psychological (verbal insult and harassment) violences are the other forms of GBV. Therefore, the objectives of this project are (1) to improve the Knowledge, Attitude and Practice (KAP) of the community towards SGBV and gender inequality through strengthened community-based prevention and response initiatives. (2) to increase the income and livelihoods of women and youth through diversified opportunities including IGAs and SHGs. (3) to improve the Psychosocial wellbeing of conflict affected community and SGBV survivors.
